objective: Design the smallest production-minded Cloud Run continuity relay for an LLM control plane. The relay must keep a bounded warm presence, expose heartbeat, job-wake and typed-result-receipt surfaces, support scheduled wake/pickup, and strictly separate control UI, durable state, model compute and runtime execution. Treat a website as UI only, not as a daemon.
acceptance_criteria: Return a minimal component and endpoint design for heartbeat, enqueue/wake, receipt pickup and health/readiness.

Specify how Cloud Run min instances, bounded concurrency, scheduler-triggered wake and idempotent job keys should interact without claiming continuous execution when no request or scheduled wake occurs.
List the five highest-risk failure modes including duplicate execution, stale receipt, unauthenticated wake, cold-state loss and false completion claims, with one mitigation each.
Provide an acceptance-test matrix that distinguishes configured, queued, executed and verified-done states.
Keep the design vendor-neutral around the LLM and durable-state backend; do not request or assume access to private repositories, Drive, credentials, account identifiers or protected topology.
falsifier: Fail if the proposal treats a web page or file store as an autonomous daemon, relies on in-memory state as durable truth, omits idempotency/receipt verification, or claims background execution without an attributable scheduled/request wake.
